signature: add(opts?: { text?, position?, attachTo?, color?, textColor?, fontSize?, iconSize?, visible? }): PoiHandle

params.name: opts.attachTo
params.desc: 关联对象, POI 跟随该对象移动

params.name: opts.iconSize
params.desc: 图标尺寸 px (canvas 渲染分辨率)

code: const poi = ssp.poiManager.add({ text: '设备 305', position: { x: 0, y: 50, z: 0 }, color: '#29ccff' }); console.log('poi created:', poi.id);
example: const a6 = ssp.objectsTool.getByUserDataProperty('floorName', 'A_6F')[0]; const pos = a6.getWorldPosition(new (window.THREE || {}).Vector3 ? new window.THREE.Vector3() : null) || { x: 0, y: 30, z: 0 }; ssp.poiManager.add({ text: 'A 楼 6 层', position: pos, color: '#ff5722' });
guard: POI 用 SpriteMaterial + CanvasTexture (WebGL 渲染), 文字清晰度高
attachTo 时 POI 会跟随该对象 (无需手动更新 position)
不传 attachTo 时 POI 是世界坐标 (不会随对象移动)
